subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers continue with the open fork PR as the fix path for this Google Chat NO_REPLY placeholder cleanup, or replace it with a maintainer-owned narrow PR?
rationale: Current main still has the bug, but the open closing PR is unmerged and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create a competing fix without a human sequencing choice.

options.title: Replace With Narrow Maintainer PR
options.body: Create or adopt a current-main patch with focused Google Chat monitor coverage and real behavior proof, then close the fork PR as superseded if needed.

options.title: Review The Fork PR
options.body: Ask for proof and refresh the open fork PR if maintainers want to preserve that exact contribution path.

options.title: Defer The Fix
options.body: Leave the issue open with no new repair job until Google Chat delivery lifecycle work is reprioritized.

recommendation.title: Replace With Narrow Maintainer PR
recommendation.body: Create or adopt a current-main patch with focused Google Chat monitor coverage and real behavior proof, then close the fork PR as superseded if needed.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the Google Chat monitor and reply-delivery lifecycle files involved in the cleanup decision.
